title.narrative: "NOSTOS: Memory of the World: documenting the lives of Greeks in Egypt

description.narrative: Nostos – The Return initiative is a meaningful project launched by the Ministry of Emigration and Egyptian Expatriates Affairs. Its primary aim is to honour and celebrate the Greek community that emigrated to Egypt many years ago and has since become an integral part of Egyptian society. This initiative recognizes the historical bond between the Greek and Egyptian communities and seeks to strengthen the cultural and social ties that have developed over the years. By acknowledging the contributions and heritage of the Greek community in Egypt, Nostos – The Return fosters a sense of appreciation and belonging among Greek Egyptians. The initiative will also serve as a reminder to share and preserve both nations' rich, intertwined history. Through a short documentary film, diverse cultural exhibition, and community engagement activities, the initiative highlights the shared experiences and mutual respect that have characterized the Greek-Egyptian relationship. Nostos – The Return embodies a gesture of gratitude and recognition towards the Greek expatriates who have contributed to Egypt's culture while reinforcing the enduring friendship between the two countries.
